 One of the tankers reports explosion off Oman while transiting Strait of Hormuz, says UK maritime agency.

 A tanker has reported an explosion off Oman while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations says. Earlier, the IRGC said two oil tankers caught fire after being struck by mines while attempting to transit the strait using “unauthorised” routes.
 US President Donald Trump has held a phone call with Qatar’s Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, in which Sheikh Tamim stressed the need for continued dialogue and diplomatic solutions to spare the region further escalation.
A seafarer was killed in an explosion believed to have been caused by a missile attack earlier this week on an oil products tanker in the Gulf, the ship’s manager reports.
